draftBreastcollar.contactNote: Same bounded field as the chest. No zero-gap or no-penetration claim; compare real skinned collar contact against the native baseline in browser QA.

tackAttachment.method: Original four-influence shoulder attachment at 70% strength, inverse-solved onto the v7 source-restored shoulder surface on reviewed breastcollar/tie islands, then the unchanged bounded static lower-V route 6 cm upward/1.2 cm forward before actor scale. Headstall, reins, fenders, irons, saddle and source skeleton stay untouched. The validated fitted surface is transported by the same smooth model-sculpt field as body, eyes, bridle and hair.
